branch_descriptions.dispatch:tie-includes-direct: the direct label is among several argmax labels but does not win uniquely; the controller dispatches so the evidence decode has a real answer to break the tie with

risk.adverse_prior: THE DELTA RETAIN-OVERRIDE. The delta >= 0.14 retain-override was the last attempt to widen dispatch beyond the alpha veto. Its registered property was ZERO LOSS BY CONSTRUCTION and it held on every exposed population (DEV-100 r4/r5, DEV-500 NEW400) and in the A4 flight. Out of sample it RECOVERED 0 OF 3 AND DAMAGED 3 OF 3 (net -3 samples, -0.60 pp) while the 11 fires in the previously-exposed half recovered 11 of 11; two of the three failures sat at delta = 0.140362, 0.000362 above the hand-fit bar. It was REMOVED from the locked cell (docs/readiness/2026-08-25-baseline-lock-verdict.md section 3; lock commit d9fef537). ALPHA IS A STRUCTURAL PARAMETER RATHER THAN A HAND-FIT RULE, so this prior does not transfer mechanically -- but the failure mode it names, that WIDENING DISPATCH DAMAGES TRAJECTORIES WHICH WERE ALREADY RIGHT, is exactly the quantity the risk column measures, and the two are reported side by side and never apart.

theorem.carve_out: the equivalence needs the trajectory to REACH the blend at all: kb_policy._advance_after_direct returns early when recall is empty or the fuser selects nothing, and such a trajectory retains without a blend being formed. Both counts are reported per carrier.
theorem.condition: alpha < 0.5 makes a RECOVERED direct label the strict, unique argmax of the blend for EVERY possible supply; alpha = 0.5 makes the worst case an exact tie, which _argmax_labels resolves as a multi-label best set and the controller therefore DISPATCHES; alpha > 0.5 lets a supply outvote the direct label.
theorem.consequence: under the locked cell 'retain == direct-label-recovered' is a PROPERTY OF THE POLICY FORM, not an empirical finding: evidence can only ever reach trajectories from which no direct label was recovered. The reachable set is the label-free set, exactly.
theorem.fused_range_argument: _fused_label_scores starts each label's raw score at best = 0.0 and only ever takes max(best, strength), so raw >= 0 for every label WHATEVER the ranker returns -- a negative or unbounded candidate score cannot make a raw label score negative. It then divides by total = sum(raw) when total > 0 and returns all-zeros otherwise. Therefore fused(label) in [0, 1] and sum(fused) in {0, 1}, by construction and not by measurement.
theorem.worst_case_for_the_direct_label: fused(direct) = 0 and some rival at fused(rival) = 1, which sum(fused) <= 1 allows only when the rival takes the whole mass

Any alpha in [0.50, 1.00) therefore selects the SAME set, and alpha behaves as a SWITCH rather than a dial

Out of sample it RECOVERED 0 OF 3 AND DAMAGED 3 OF 3 (net -3 samples, -0.60 pp) while the 11 fires in the previously-exposed half recovered 11 of 11; two of the three failures sat at delta = 0.140362, 0.000362 above the hand-fit bar. It was REMOVED from the locked cell (docs/readiness/2026-08-25-baseline-lock-verdict.md section 3; lock commit d9fef537). theorem.consequence: under the locked cell 'retain == direct-label-recovered' is a PROPERTY OF THE POLICY FORM, not an empirical finding: evidence can only ever reach trajectories from which no direct label was recovered. The reachable set is the label-free set, exactly.
